title: OL-20261121-2: Buffer app registration: the connect flow cannot self-register
body:
**Owner:** social-module
**Trigger:** smoke-live run
**Done check:** grep:scripts/smoke_live.py::buffer-registration
**Status:** closed

Buffer documents app clients created in its settings and no open registration endpoint; the connect flow's self-registration failed in production. The smoke check buffer-registration records the live answer each run and the connect flow logs the reason to credential_events. Default in effect: Bluesky posts natively, the relay carries X, LinkedIn, Substack and Mastodon. Next route when registration stays refused: native LinkedIn and Mastodon credentials, then an owner-created Buffer client stored through the credential store.

**Vacuous:** 2026-11-21T17:01:12Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists


**Evidence:** closing probe passes on main (2026-11-21); the contract verdict was vacuous because the item was filed from a transient reading and the probe never failed after filing. Closed by queue.close with this evidence.
